title: Jovial Brazilian Bean Stew
description: A briny and comforting Brazilian dish featuring red wine and a nimono-simmer, perfect for a cold evening. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly stew is made in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Heat the Dutch oven over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the soaked and drained black beans, red wine, tomato paste, vegetable broth, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour, or until the beans are tender.
Use a potato masher to mash some of the beans and vegetables, if desired, to thicken the stew.
Simmer the stew, uncovered, for an additional 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, to reduce the liquid and intensify the flavors.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Let the stew cool, then refrigerate or freeze it for later use.
